# Audit Event Matrix

**Phase 1, step 5.** Generated by `scripts/lifecycle/gen_audit_matrix.py` from the migrated database; do not edit by hand. Re-run `scripts/lifecycle/regenerate.sh`.

The docket (Rule Group 10, B79) names 14 classes of sensitive action. For each: which action codes exist, where the record is written, and whether the trail names who, what and when. `tests/test_audit_coverage.sql` performs every class and checks the record, then checks what the record must not contain (secrets, hashes).

**Result:** 14 of 14 classes have at least one catalogued action; 21 action codes (17 written to `audit.audit_event`, 4 evidenced by a domain ledger that is itself append-only).

## 1. Coverage by class

| # | Sensitive action | Action code | Recorded in | Meaning |
|--:|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Session creation (successful login) | `auth.login` | `audit.audit_event` | A session was created after a successful login |
| 2 | Authentication failure | `auth.failed` | `audit.audit_event` | A login attempt failed (unknown account, wrong password, locked) |
| 3 | Session revocation | `session.revoked` | `audit.audit_event` | A session or device was revoked |
| 4 | Device entitlement breach | `device.limit_exceeded` | `audit.audit_event` | A login was refused because the device entitlement was reached |
| 5 | Credential change | `credential.changed` | `audit.audit_event` | A credential was set, rotated, deactivated or expired |
| 6 | Role or permission assignment change | `role.assigned` | `audit.audit_event` | A user was given a platform or organisation role |
|  |  | `role_permission.changed` | `audit.audit_event` | A permission was granted to or removed from a role |
|  |  | `role.removed` | `audit.audit_event` | A user lost a platform or organisation role |
| 7 | Account status change | `account.status_changed` | `audit.audit_event` | An account or organisation status changed (suspend, close, reactivate) |
|  |  | `user.erased` | `audit.audit_event` | An account was erased on request or after inactivity |
| 8 | Administrative impersonation | `admin.impersonation_ended` | `audit.audit_event` | An administrator stopped acting as another user |
|  |  | `admin.impersonation_started` | `audit.audit_event` | An administrator began acting as another user |
| 9 | Consent grant or withdrawal | `consent.changed` | `audit.audit_event` | Consent was granted, changed or withdrawn |
| 10 | Block or unblock of a user or organisation | `block.changed` | `audit.audit_event` | A user or organisation was blocked or unblocked |
| 11 | Candidate profile view, unlock or download | `profile.downloaded` | `commercial.candidate_profile_download_history` (append-only ledger) | A candidate profile was downloaded |
|  |  | `profile.viewed` | `profile.profile_view_history` (append-only ledger) | A candidate profile was viewed |
| 12 | Application stage change | `application.stage_changed` | `recruitment.application_status_history` (append-only ledger) | An application moved to another stage |
| 13 | Wallet transaction | `wallet.transaction` | `commercial.wallet_ledger` (append-only ledger) | Credit was added, spent or corrected |
| 14 | Payment, refund or licence change | `licence.changed` | `audit.audit_event` | A licence, seat or subscription was created or changed |
|  |  | `payment.changed` | `audit.audit_event` | A payment order was created or changed state |
|  |  | `refund.issued` | `audit.audit_event` | A refund was issued |

## 2. How events get written

Row triggers call `audit.log_change()` on these tables, so a change cannot be made without leaving the record:

| Table | Trigger |
|:--|:--|
| `commercial.licence_seat_allocation` | `trg_licence_seat_audit` |
| `commercial.payment_order` | `trg_payment_order_audit` |
| `commercial.payment_refund` | `trg_payment_refund_audit` |
| `commercial.subscription` | `trg_subscription_audit` |
| `commercial.subscription_licence` | `trg_subscription_licence_audit` |
| `core.consent_record` | `trg_consent_record_audit` |
| `core.identity_verification` | `trg_identity_verification_audit` |
| `core.role_permission` | `trg_role_permission_audit` |
| `core.user_account` | `trg_user_account_status_audit` |
| `core.user_block` | `trg_user_block_audit` |
| `core.user_credential` | `trg_user_credential_audit` |
| `core.user_role` | `trg_user_role_audit` |
| `recruitment.organization` | `trg_organization_status_audit` |
| `recruitment.organization_member` | `trg_organization_member_audit` |

Functions that write `audit.audit_event` themselves (they know more than a row trigger can: outcome, device, reason): `core.begin_impersonation`, `core.create_session_with_device_limit`, `core.end_impersonation`, `core.erase_user_account`, `core.record_login_failure`, `core.revoke_user_session`.

## 3. Properties of the audit table (read from the catalogue)

| Property | Now | Why it matters |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Tenant column `organization_id` | yes | An organisation administrator can be shown their own events only (view `audit.org_audit_event`) |
| Action must exist in the catalogue | yes (foreign key) | A misspelt action code cannot be written, so coverage can be counted |
| Actor foreign keys | ON DELETE RESTRICT | An actor with history cannot be deleted; erasure anonymises instead |
| TRUNCATE blocked | yes | A row trigger does not fire on TRUNCATE |
| Updates and deletes refused | yes (`audit.prevent_modification`) | The trail is evidence |
| Row-level security | no (grants only) | Who may read the trail |
| `audit.system_error_log` tamper guard | yes | Operational errors are the least protected log |

## 4. Known limits

- `entity_id` is a single `BIGINT`; an action on a table with a composite key records the surrogate id only.
- Payload columns (`old_values_json`, `new_values_json`) are not indexed; searching them scans. Search by actor, action, entity or time instead (indexed).
- Domain ledgers (profile view, download, application stage, wallet) evidence classes 11 to 13 with actor and time but without client address; DEC-14 in `docs/lifecycle/decision-log.md` records why.
- Executed by: `tests/test_audit_coverage.sql`.
